arguments.explanation: Flags a random sample of about 1% of transactions, chosen independently of their content, for manual review.
assumptions: The 1% is applied per transaction using a random number, so the flagged set is approximately 1% and differs each time the rule runs.
The sample is drawn from all transactions, including those without a fraud label.
The rule does not use any transaction attributes, so it is not a fraud signal; it is a sampling control.
